subject: Warner Bros. Studio Tour London - GetYourGuide packages compared
method: Each product page opened in the Browser pane at getyourguide.com/en-gb/activity/-t<id>. Inclusions, exclusions, meeting point, provider, duration and rating read from the page's embedded state and visible text; 'fromPrice' is the page's schema.org AggregateOffer lowPrice. Dated prices are the booking panel total for one adult (or 2 adults + 2 youth where stated), reached with ?date_from=<date>&date_to=<date> and 'Check availability'. Cookie banner answered 'Only essential'.

diyBaseline.familyNote: Family price exists only in the operator's own booking flow; no GetYourGuide package offers it.
diyBaseline.journey: Euston to Watford Junction 18-21 min, shuttle 15 min

keyFindings: GetYourGuide package prices move by date; the operator's £58.50 does not. 'From' prices are the cheapest calendar date and were beaten by every dated check: 31392 from £75 but £87-£114; 679208 from £74.50 but £119.20-£149; 63735 from £100 but £175-£194; 491628 from £90 but £202.
Every product checked includes Studio Tour entry. None includes a guide except 63735.

The coach day out is one product sold by four companies: Premium Tours (31392, Victoria Coach Station), Axis & Globe (505308, Bedford Way, Bloomsbury), Evan Evans (52391, Victoria / Paddington / Marble Arch) and Golden Tours (16403 Victoria, 82665 King's Cross). All roughly 4 hours inside. 31392 has the most reviews and was cheapest on three of four dates.
679208 is the same Euston train and free shuttle as doing it yourself, with no escort, at £46-£76 more on the dates checked.

Packages still had seats on a date the operator had sold out: Saturday 19 September 2026 was sold out on the operator's site on 12 September (data/studio-tour.json); on 13 September 31392 had seats at £87 and 16403 at £97.75.
For a family of 2 adults + 2 youth on 24 November 2026: 31392 £392 (adult £103, youth £93), 16403 £490 (adult £125, youth £120), against £188 direct plus train fares.
